items.raw_excerpt: For 25 years, afpop, the largest association for foreigners in Portugal, have hosted their annual exhibition. This year the event returns but with a new name – afpop expo.
items.summary_en: For 25 years, afpop has held its annual exhibition for foreigners in Portugal. This year the event returns as afpop expo. It has a new name and more to offer.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈 최대 외국인 협회인 afpop이 25년째 매년 전시회를 열어 왔다. 올해 행사는 새 이름인 afpop 엑스포로 돌아온다. 이번에는 더 많은 프로그램이 추가됐다.
items.title_en: afpop Expo Returns With a New Name After 25 Years
items.title_ko: 포르투갈 외국인 협회 afpop 엑스포, 새 이름으로 25년 만에 돌아와
items.title_original: afpop expo – the event you have always loved, but now with more!

items.raw_excerpt: Jusqu’au 22 septembre, la place de la République prend des airs de piazza italienne avec le Village Passione Italiana. Pour sa 16e édition, l’événement invite les Lyonnais à découvrir les saveurs, l’artisanat et les spécialités de toute la péninsule.
items.summary_en: Place de la Republique in Lyon is hosting an Italian food village called Village Passione Italiana. Now in its 16th year, the event lets locals taste food, crafts, and specialties from across Italy.
items.summary_ko: 리옹 레퓌블리크 광장에서 '빌라지 파시오네 이탈리아나'라는 이탈리아 음식 마을이 열린다. 16회째를 맞은 이번 행사에서는 이탈리아 각지의 음식과 공예, 특산물을 맛보고 볼 수 있다.
items.title_en: Italian Food Village Arrives in Lyon Until September 22
items.title_original: Un grand village dédié à la gastronomie italienne débarque à Lyon jusqu'au 22 septembre - Le Bonbon

items.raw_excerpt: Tucked away in the green surroundings of Carona, Aldona, The Village Casa is a restored Portuguese-era home that offers something increasingly rare in Goa, a chance to slow down and experience the character of an old village house. Set beside fields, a waterway and lush tropical vegetation, the heritage villa combines its original architecture and […]
items.summary_en: The Village Casa is an old Portuguese-era home in Goa. It was restored into a quiet place to stay. Guests can relax and feel the charm of a village life.
items.summary_ko: 빌리지 카사는 고아에 있는 포르투갈 시대 옛 가옥을 복원한 곳이다. 밭과 물길, 무성한 열대 식물에 둘러싸여 있다. 방문객은 천천히 머물며 옛 마을집의 분위기를 느낄 수 있다.
items.title_en: A restored old house in a Goa village

items.raw_excerpt: As traditional banks increasingly spurn their US clients who live overseas, international credit unions may be a viable option for the banking and investment needs of Americans living in Germany.
items.summary_en: US banks often refuse clients who live overseas. International credit unions can serve Americans in Germany. They offer banking and investment services for them.
items.summary_ko: 미국 은행들은 해외 거주 고객을 점점 더 받지 않고 있습니다. 국제 신용협동조합이 독일에 사는 미국인들의 은행 거래와 투자 서비스 대안이 될 수 있습니다.
items.title_en: International credit unions for Americans in Germany
items.title_ko: 독일 거주 미국인을 위한 국제 신용협동조합 안내
items.title_original: How Americans in Germany can benefit from international credit unions

items.raw_excerpt: Make this your new Italian sign-off.
items.summary_en: Ci sentiamo is a common Italian way to say goodbye. Use it as your sign-off. It means let us stay in touch.
items.summary_ko: Ci sentiamo는 이탈리아어로 작별 인사할 때 자주 쓰는 말이다. 말을 맺는 인사말로 쓰면 좋다. '연락하자'라는 뜻이다.
items.title_en: Italian expression of the day: Ci sentiamo
items.title_original: Italian expression of the day: 'Ci sentiamo'

items.raw_excerpt: Moving to Norway often comes with steep integration hurdles, particularly when it comes to breaking through the tight-knit local social circles. To help international residents build a sense of belonging, the founder of Unlock Norway has launched Welcome Week. Will you join the events?
items.summary_en: Moving to Norway can be hard, especially when it is difficult to join local social circles. The founder of Unlock Norway has started Welcome Week to help international residents feel that they belong. The events are open for everyone to join.
items.summary_ko: 노르웨이로 이주하면 특히 현지 사람들의 둥근 모임에 끼기 어려워 적응이 힘든 경우가 많습니다. 언락 노르웨이는 국제 주민들이 소속감을 느낄 수 있도록 웰컴 위크를 시작했습니다. 누구든 이 행사에 참여할 수 있습니다.
items.title_en: Norway Opens Its Doors: What to Know About Welcome Week
items.title_ko: 노르웨이가 문을 열다: 웰컴 위크에 대해 알아야 할 것
items.title_original: 'Norway opens its doors': What international residents should know about 'Welcome Week'

items.raw_excerpt: The Raiders have claimed a first-ever NRLW finals win, downing the Tigers 6-0 to end Wests' fairytale season.
items.summary_en: The Canberra Raiders claimed their first-ever NRLW finals win. They beat the Wests Tigers 6-0. The loss ended Wests' fairytale season.
items.summary_ko: 캔버라 레이더스가 사상 첫 NRLW 플레이오프 경기에서 승리를 따냈다. 레이더스는 타이거스를 6-0으로 눌렀다. 이로써 웨스트스의 동화 같은 시즌은 막을 내렸다.
items.title_en: Canberra ends Wests' NRLW fairytale with 6-0 finals win

items.title_original: Canberra ends Wests' NRLW fairytale in finals shut out

items.raw_excerpt: Umlibo, a 5×2 m tapestry stitched by 41 women and two men in a remote village on the Eastern Cape coast, goes to auction in Cape Town on 15 September 2026. First unveiled in 2023, the Umlibo tapestry is the handiwork of the Keiskamma Art Project whose advocacy work is world-renowned. The tapestry takes its […]
items.summary_en: The Umlibo tapestry was made by 41 women and two men in a remote village on the Eastern Cape coast. The 5 by 2 meter work carries the village's climate story. It goes to auction in Cape Town on 15 September 2026.
items.summary_ko: 움리보 태피스트리는 동부케이프 해안의 외진 마을에서 여성 41명과 남성 2명이 손으로 짠 작품이다. 크기는 가로 5미터, 세로 2미터이며 마을의 기후 이야기를 담고 있다. 2026년 9월 15일 케이프타운에서 경매에 오른다.
items.title_en: Eastern Cape Village Tapestry Goes Up for Auction
items.title_ko: 동부케이프 마을의 태피스트리, 케이프타운 경매에 나온다
items.title_original: Tapestry that took an Eastern Cape village’s climate story to the world goes up for auction - Farmers Review Africa
